title: Seated Chest Pass Accuracy
description: Partners work on a crisp, accurate chest pass delivered from a stationary seated position, the foundation pass every other passing drill in the chair builds on.

content.objective: Deliver a flat, accurate seated chest pass that arrives right at the partner's chest.
content.setup: Partners sit four metres apart facing each other, one ball per pair.
instructions: Push the ball with both thumbs from the chest, snapping the wrists on release.
Aim for the partner's chest, not their lap or their face.
Catch with both hands and give a target before returning the pass.
After two minutes, move one metre further apart and repeat.
coachingPoints: Use the trunk, not just the arms, to add power to the pass.
Finish with the thumbs pointing down and away after release.
Keep the chair stable and square to the target through the pass.
commonMistakes: Passing with the arms alone and leaving the trunk out of it.
Letting the chair rock or turn during the release.
Passing from a standstill instead of stepping the chair into it.
content.safety: Keep pairs spaced well apart so a stray pass doesn't hit a neighbouring group.
